notes.title: Finally Released
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44050357/ce4cf4d8bde055ee3f73dfe1feae1127c9553b95.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44050357/f54d9372525b5aa8b7101799ec9ccde2215e196f.png[/img][/url]

We have officially launched this week and this has been a long and let's say sleepless road for me.
I am extremely happy to have launched Asura's Trial and bring my dream project to end.
I would like to thank all my friends who helped and my wife who supported me in making Asura's Trial.
I really hope anyone who buys it enjoys what i have made and any shares or word of mouth would help a great deal in making the game more visible. 
Thanks a lot everyone and also thank you for your support[url=

notes.title: Status Update
notes.content:
First, I would like to thank everybody who is following or added the game on their wish-list.
This is my first game to be released and as a solo developer it has been quite a challenging trial but with time and effort I shall soon see it finished :)

As some might have seen, I have changed the original release date from late May to late July in order to conduct additional balancing and also add some additional features and quality of life adjustments.
I think if this is my dream-project I want people to have a good polished product when they play it. 

In the coming months I will also focus on doing some marketing and awareness but being the only one developing and testing to some extent it might prove a bit difficult to multi-task that much.
Any sharing of this game to others to raise awareness will help a lot and would mean the world to me as well :)
I will add this week a new trailer showcasing a more complex encounter from start to finish 

Thanks a lot for everything,
Andrei Balint
